name: Joined Wings [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You have developed a deep rapport with your comrades that allows you to swiftly convey divine grace.

Prerequisite(s): Fervor or lay on hands class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use your lay on hands or the healing granted by fervor on allies as a swift action.
